description.p: 1989 is an emulator of the NeXT family of Motorola 68K based workstations (NeXT Computer, NeXTcube, NeXTcube Turbo, NeXTstation and NeXTstation Color). It is built on the Previous NeXT emulator code base and uses the SDL3 display, options-dialog, and status-bar conventions of the sibling projects (1983, 1984, 1985, 1986). The m68k core comes from WinUAE; the i860 NeXTdimension emulation comes from Jason Eckhardt.
